collection.name: Cream Cats
collection.summary: BTC Ordinals Cream Cats collection using imported inscription metadata with Satflow rendered previews for token artwork.

sources.metadataSource: btc ordinal inscription metadata plus Satflow rendered inscription previews

canonicalIdentity.notes: Each Cream Cats BTC Ordinals token is keyed by inscription ID and rendered through Satflow preview images.

formula.name: Normalized average inverse trait frequency
formula.explanation: Each trait weight is collection supply divided by that trait occurrence count. Trait Count is included as its own scoring trait. A token score is the average of all trait weights, including Trait Count, so fewer-slot and higher-slot tokens are compared through explicit occurrence rarity instead of hidden slot-count bias.
